other_conditions: The beneficiary must be a permanent resident of Maharashtra State
The applicant must be a farmer and possess an Aadhaar Card
The applicant must provide a 7/12 land ownership certificate
The applicant must provide an 8‑A certificate
Farmers from the Konkan division are eligible for land parcels between 0.10 and 10.00 hectares
Farmers from the rest of Maharashtra are eligible for land parcels between 0.20 and 6.00 hectares
The farmer must maintain a fruit plant survival rate of at least 80% in the first year and 90% in the second year
benefits_summary: Direct Benefit Transfer subsidy for planting 16 perennial fruit crops, covering activities such as pit digging, planting grafts/seedlings, fertilizer application, crop protection and gap filling.
